method.scoring: Each indicator gets 1 (Stable), 2 (Watch: moves the harmful way, not significant) or 3 (Alarming: harmful and p < 0.05, Mann-Kendall). Trend slope: Theil-Sen.
method.risk_score: Mean of the available indicator scores. Low < 1.7, Medium < 2.4, High otherwise.
method.stress_index: Mean z-score of (-NDVI, -soil moisture, +daytime land temperature) against the point's own 2015-2025 history. harder > +0.5, easier < -0.5.
method.coast_proxy: Distance to coast is a hand-entered approximation used as a salinity-exposure proxy (<=10 km -> 3, <=40 km -> 2, else 1). Salinity is not measured.
method.data_cleaning: NDVI: cloud-flagged pixels removed. Land temperature: fill values removed. Soil moisture: monthly mean. A year needs >= 6 valid months to enter an annual series.
method.disclaimer: Indicative screening based on NASA satellite data. Values describe the area around each point, not a specific field.
